dedupe_keys.name: charged ev charging data analysis and evaluation scripts

description: The Intelligent Systems Lab publishes CHARGED analysis and prediction code alongside its charging dataset. The GitHub repository contains API, script and example directories; the README describes cleaning, aggregation, model evaluation and federated learning across city datasets. It is publicly visible without a fee. The README states MIT, but its linked LICENSE file is absent and GitHub reports no licence, so software reuse rights need confirmation. The tools can prepare and compare electric-vehicle charging demand inputs for capacity-planning simulations, with data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging as a separate comparison dataset. A caveat is that city-specific data availability and time alignment affect cross-city model transfer. Federated results also depend on the exact partition and model configuration. Repository structure and documentation were inspected, but code execution and predictive performance were not tested. The licensed Zenodo data deposit is assessed separately.
